ownerPreconditions.requirement: Merge the additive Rules fragment into the oracle project and publish it. The fragment grants nothing to unauthenticated callers.

Create one throwaway email/password account owned by the campaign operator in the oracle project. Its password is supplied to the collector through a private file descriptor, never through argv or the environment.
ownerPreconditions.verifiable: exactly one account identifier appears in the receipt

ownerPreconditions.requirement: No composite index is needed: the query filters and orders on the same field, which the automatic single-field index serves.
ownerPreconditions.verifiable: no FAILED_PRECONDITION index error in the receipt

ownerPreconditions.requirement: The nonce-scoped run document and the private document must not exist before the run.
ownerPreconditions.verifiable: preflight absence rows for every owned path

allows: one run of the declared case catalog against the oracle project
at most one throwaway account sign-in and sign-out
creation and conditional deletion of the declared owned documents
forbids: reuse of any earlier compat-broad permission
any write outside the nonce-scoped run document and the private document
any retry after the deadline or the hard cost ceiling
recording an identity token, refresh token or password in any output

unobservedPaths.plan: A separate browser campaign driving the same case catalog through a headless Chromium page against the same oracle project, with the WebChannel request log captured from the page rather than from Node.
unobservedPaths.reason: The Node SDK build selects the gRPC transport; WebChannel framing, long-poll fallback and browser tab lifecycle are not exercised.

unobservedPaths.plan: An instrumented Android test module that replays the same case catalog and emits the same normalized event rows for comparison.
unobservedPaths.reason: No Android runtime, Gradle toolchain or device is available to this lane.

unobservedPaths.plan: An XCTest target replaying the same case catalog and emitting the same normalized event rows.
unobservedPaths.reason: No iOS or macOS SDK harness exists in this repository.

unobservedPaths.plan: A direct gRPC Listen probe that supplies a chosen resume token and records the TargetChange response, kept as a separate case from SDK-level resume.
unobservedPaths.reason: The Node client SDK owns the resume token; it is not exposed to application code, so RESET and stale-token behavior cannot be driven here.
